notes: Iterative amplitude estimation (qiskit-algorithms IterativeAmplitudeEstimation, epsilon_target=0.01 on the amplitude a = count/256, confidence 95%, 100 shots per round, Grover powers [0, 0, 1, 6, 33]) on the Aer statevector SIMULATOR, seeded. The oracle is a reversible circuit: per-hour Hamming weight by controlled increments, comparison with the quota, AND with 'protected feeders are on'. Tolerance = max(CI half-width in counts, 1 plan) = 1.000; within_tolerance means the exact count is inside the CI or within the tolerance of the estimate. The exact count comes from enumerating all 256 strings; at 8 search qubits this is classically trivial, so no quantum speed-up is claimed. oracle_queries counts shots x Grover power over all rounds (Q-calls, from the IAE result). Runtime of the simulation: 0.48 s. Cross-check: enumeration equals exact.n_valid = 9 in the plans file.
